label: illustrative
purpose: Agent-authored public-task development experiment, not production or human-judged acceptance
catalogScope: All 212 records in the repository snapshot; not the whole MCP ecosystem
hypothesis: Capability tags may be more specific than prose descriptions; prioritize those attributes without changing fields, query text, default ranking rules or documents.
split: 16 development, 8 holdout; task-family pairs stay in one split; no retuning after holdout is evaluated
judging: Separate AI assessor, source/rank-blinded pool, public capability references, independent catalog supplementation for zero-result queries. AI judgments are not human labels or user feedback.
negativeResultPolicy: Keep the unchanged production configuration when any gate fails. Publish reproducible negative findings without changing labels or queries to manufacture gains.
limits: Small purposive sample; no statistical significance claim
AI assessment has correlated-model and incomplete-documentation risks
Recall denominator is independently identified relevant items within this snapshot, not exhaustive real-world coverage
No satisfaction, user-log representativeness or business-percentage targets are evaluated
